title: Reverse engineering run out of national labs
summary: Matthew Brown tells of Reverse engineering run out of national labs, about ongoing at US national labs and defense contractors, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.
place_text: US national labs and defense contractors

tellings.quote: something like that is is ongoing and is ran out of our national labs for sure
national labs are where uh samples are stored of exotic technologies
tellings.difference: Stresses that the labs store samples of exotic technology, not only that the work is run from them.
tellings.link_reason: Matthew Brown again places exotic technology work at US national labs, the same claim as the story that reverse engineering is run out of national labs.

as_told.title: National labs store samples of exotic technology
